From 7354eb7f1558466e92e926802d36e69e42938ea9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Curtis Malainey <cujomalainey@chromium.org>
Date: Wed, 31 Jul 2024 14:21:44 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: SOF: Remove libraries from topology lookups

Default firmware shipped in open source are not licensed for 3P
libraries, therefore topologies should not reference them.

If a OS wants to use 3P (that they have licensed) then they should use
the appropriate topology override mechanisms.

Fixes: 8a7d5d85ed2161 ("ASoC: SOF: mediatek: mt8195: Add devicetree support to select topologies")
Signed-off-by: Curtis Malainey <cujomalainey@chromium.org>
Cc: Wojciech Macek <wmacek@google.com>
Reviewed-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@collabora.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20240731212153.921327-1-cujomalainey@chromium.org
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/sof/mediatek/mt8195/mt8195.c b/sound/soc/sof/mediatek/mt8195/mt8195.c
index 24ae1d4959be..1c6e035fd313 100644
--- a/sound/soc/sof/mediatek/mt8195/mt8195.c
+++ b/sound/soc/sof/mediatek/mt8195/mt8195.c
@@ -573,7 +573,7 @@ static const struct snd_sof_dsp_ops sof_mt8195_ops = {
 static struct snd_sof_of_mach sof_mt8195_machs[] = {
 	{
 		.compatible = "google,tomato",
-		.sof_tplg_filename = "sof-mt8195-mt6359-rt1019-rt5682-dts.tplg"
+		.sof_tplg_filename = "sof-mt8195-mt6359-rt1019-rt5682.tplg"
 	}, {
 		.compatible = "mediatek,mt8195",
 		.sof_tplg_filename = "sof-mt8195.tplg"
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `sound/soc/sof/mediatek/mt8195/mt8195.c`**
   - The line defining the `sof_tplg_filename` for the compatible device `"google,tomato"` was modified. 
   - The original filename `"sof-mt8195-mt6359-rt1019-rt5682-dts.tplg"` was changed to `"sof-mt8195-mt6359-rt1019-rt5682.tplg"`, effectively removing the reference to a specific device tree source (DTS) file.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `mt8195.c` file is part of a broader effort to ensure that the default firmware shipped in open source does not reference third-party (3P) libraries, which are not licensed for use. By removing the reference to the DTS file in the topology filename, the patch aligns with the goal of preventing the use of unlicensed libraries in the topology lookups. This change is a direct response to the identified issue in the previous commit (Fixes: 8a7d5d85ed2161) that added device tree support for selecting topologies.

The root cause of the bug is that the default firmware provided in open source does not have the necessary licenses to use third-party (3P) libraries.
